name: Observe EY, PYP and MLC classes
evidence: Observation records – EY, PYP, and MLC

name: Observe parent meetings
what: Observe five parent meetings conducted by an experienced SC, TL or team member, with a structured focus.

name: Viva
what: Take the Readiness Viva: a scenario-based conversation that assesses your readiness to work independently as a Student Champion.
evidence: Viva record; certifying mentor or TL notes
standard: Responds to scenarios by applying the SC role, boundaries, programme processes, confidentiality, stakeholder collaboration and student support; the focus is on sound reasoning, not a perfect answer

name: Graduation Presentation
what: Reflect on your three-month Student Champion journey (key learnings, experiences, strategies, growth, collaboration and goals) and present it in a clear, experience-based presentation.
standard: Presents a clear, honest, experience-based reflection on learning, growth, student engagement, collaboration and next steps
